facts.text: John has a collection of books on a shelf.

evidence.quote: I'm a huge fan of Lord of the Rings! The adventure, the world, and the characters are awesome. [image: a photo of a shelf with a lot of books on it]

facts.text: John has a collection of DVDs and games on a bookcase.

evidence.quote: Have you watched them heaps? Got any favorite characters from those movies? [image: a photo of a bookcase filled with dvds and games]

facts.text: John's favorite character from the Lord of the Rings movies is Aragorn.

evidence.quote: My favorite character is Aragorn, he grows so much throughout the story.

facts.text: John believes Aragorn becomes king because he is a great leader who puts others first.

evidence.quote: He's a great leader and puts others first - that's why he eventually becomes king.
